title: Von Braun collecting lunar meteorites in Antarctica; NASA ceramics lab

tellings.quote: Von Braonn picked him up from Antarctica. There's a picture of that on the web. Picking up lunar meteorites before he went to the moon for the first time.

plain: On Jesse Michels's podcast, a researcher named Bart Sibrel says that Wernher von Braun, the rocket engineer who led NASA's moon rocket work, went to Antarctica in the 1960s to pick up lunar meteorites, rocks from the Moon that fell to Earth, before any astronauts reached the Moon, and that a picture of this is online. He also mentions a NASA ceramics lab run by an unnamed contractor. If true, it would raise questions about where NASA's moon rock samples really came from.
